company: TR Anadolu Metal Madencilik İşletmeleri A.Ş.

mines.mine_notes: 47.55% effective indirect interest through Türk Altın İşletmeleri A.Ş. (TRALT). Underground mine, Bergama/İzmir; ore processed at Ovacık central tank-leach plant. Per-mine production not disclosed by operator. See TRALT.IS.json.
47.55% effective indirect interest through Türk Altın İşletmeleri A.Ş. Underground mine near Ovacık; ore trucked to Ovacık central plant. See TRALT.IS.json.
47.55% effective indirect interest through Türk Altın İşletmeleri A.Ş. Open pit mine, Eskişehir, with own plant. See TRALT.IS.json.

99.04% subsidiary (Özdemir Antimuan Madenleri A.Ş.), Turhal. Turkey's first private mining operation; antimony concentrate production (~1.5% world market share). 7,571 ha across 8 operating licences; 2 licences currently producing, rest exploration/development. Non-gold asset.
71.77% subsidiary (Konaklı Metal Madencilik, JV with Teck Madencilik A.Ş.; Konaklı is operator of Konak project). Exploration, drilling and analysis ongoing. Non-producing.

notes: Company renamed from Koza Anadolu Metal İşletmeleri A.Ş. (ticker KOZAA) to TR Anadolu Metal Madencilik İşletmeleri A.Ş. (ticker TRMET) on 6 Nov 2025. Essentially a holding company: Türk Altın İşletmeleri A.Ş. (47.55% effective) accounts for 91% of consolidated assets, 92% of equity, 95% of revenue. Attributable FY2025 gold production = 47.55% of Türk Altın's 118,300 oz ≈ 56,252 oz; attributable silver ≈ 25,962 oz. Consolidated FY2025: revenue TL17,705.4M, net profit TL3,977.6M, cash position TL18,631.4M. Also owns dairy (ATP Koza Gıda) and hotel (TR Otelcilik/Angel's Marmaris) subsidiaries.
